name: Airfoil Design Simulation
description: The task involves predicting steady-state 2D velocity and pressure fields around airfoils in a subsonic regime, using ML-based surrogate models to reduce simulation costs while maintaining accuracy. The goal is to maximize the lift-over-drag ratio and ensure generalization to out-of-distribution scenarios.

cr:input.name: AirfRANS dataset
cr:input.description: The dataset consists of CFD simulations represented as point clouds defined via the nodes of a 2D simulation mesh. Inputs include positions, inlet velocity, distance to the airfoil, and normals. The dataset is split into training (103 samples), test (200 samples), and OOD test (496 samples) sets.
